tool_schemas.name: stagehand_navigate
tool_schemas.description: Navigates the specified Stagehand browser session to an absolute URL and appends a `navigate` command (with its resulting navigation output) to the session timeline, returning the recorded command result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is not a valid Stagehand session ULID or if `url` is missing/invalid or not absolute, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to use the session, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed configured request or usage limits.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this navigate command to.

url.description: Absolute URL to navigate the session to.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_act
tool_schemas.description: Executes a single, atomic action instruction (e.g., click/type/select) against the current page in the specified session, appends an `act` command to the session timeline, and returns the recorded command output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid or `action` is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT when the session cannot accept a new command (for example, if it is already executing or otherwise not in a runnable state).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this act command to.

action.description: Atomic, specific action instruction to perform on the current page (e.g., click/type/select).

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_extract
tool_schemas.description: Extracts the page text from the current page in the specified session, appends an `extract` command to the session timeline, and returns the extracted text artifact in the command output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where extraction can run (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this extract command to.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_observe
tool_schemas.description: Observes actionable elements on the current page in the specified session, appends an `observe` command to the session timeline, and returns the observed element metadata in the command output for later use in actions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session cannot run an observation (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this observe command to.

tool_schemas.name: screenshot
tool_schemas.description: Captures a screenshot of the current page in the specified session, appends a `screenshot` command to the session timeline, and returns the screenshot artifact reference in the command output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where a screenshot can be taken (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this screenshot command to.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_create_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new stateful Stagehand browser session in the caller's workspace and returns the session record. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if credentials are missing/invalid or the API key is revoked, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace has exceeded its sessions-per-day quota.

browser_provider.description: Browser backend/provider to use for this session.

expires_in_seconds.description: Requested session TTL in seconds; the service may clamp to workspace limits.

metadata.description: Optional opaque metadata to attach to the session for auditing/debugging.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_get_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single browser session by id and returns its current state (including status, current URL/title, and timestamps). Refuses NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to the caller.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_list_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists browser sessions in the caller's workspace with optional filtering and cursor pagination. Returns sessions ordered by created_at descending. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if credentials are missing/invalid.

created_after.description: Only return sessions created after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return sessions created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_end_session
tool_schemas.description: Ends a running/created Stagehand browser session and transitions it to status=ended, preventing any new queued commands. Returns the updated session. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the session is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the session is already ended/error or cannot transition per lifecycle rules.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to end.

tool_schemas.name: stagehand_list_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists page artifacts (extracted text, observed elements, screenshots) for a given session, with optional filtering and cursor pagination. Returns artifact metadata and inline content for text/element artifacts; screenshot artifacts return a blob_url reference. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the session is not accessible.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID whose artifacts to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Stagehand
metadata.description: Stagehand is a browser-automation backend that maintains stateful browsing sessions and records the sequence of agent-issued commands (navigate/act/extract/observe/screenshot) along with their outputs. The main workflow is: create or resume a session, run tools that append commands to a session time
